notes_for_editor: Only one history line exists: the 1947 erection of a 67-foot tower, quoted from a 1948 state report on the lookout-history page. No staffing, fire, fate, access or current-status source was found. Search returned two TopoQuest entries near Boone (WATA-AM, WASU-FM), which are radio towers and were not used. A 1980 Watauga Democrat piece describes a fire spotter in the Dugger Mountain tower, a different tower (NCT053), and was not used. The brief's agency and height match source 1. Story is about 110 words, under the 120-word guide floor, because the evidence is this thin.
